shortDescription: Manage Atlas Federation role mappings for SAML/OIDC groups

options.name: api_password
options.description: Atlas API private key. Alternative to C(service_account_secret).

options.name: api_username
options.description: Atlas API public key. Alternative to C(service_account_id).

options.name: external_group_name
options.description: Name of the external IdP group (e.g. AD/SAML group name).

options.name: federation_settings_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the federation settings.

options.name: org_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the Atlas organization.

options.name: role_assignments
options.description: List of Atlas role assignments for this group.

options.name: service_account_id
options.description: MongoDB Atlas Service Account client ID (OAuth2). Mutually exclusive with C(api_username).

options.name: service_account_secret
options.description: MongoDB Atlas Service Account client secret (OAuth2). Mutually exclusive with C(api_password).

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the role mapping.
